slots.questionIntent: Classify local default state and remote backend storage by persistence and collaboration properties.

expectedOutcome.resolution: Recognize when shared, durable state requires a remote backend or HCP Terraform.

slots.errorModelOrFailureMode: Treat a version-control repository as an acceptable shared state backend.
slots.decisiveBoundary: Shared state requires supported secure access and must not be inferred from file sharing alone.
overlapExclusions: Does not select a provider-specific backend implementation.
A slot with the same semantic fingerprint is duplicate even if its wording or scenario nouns differ.

neighborDistinctness.explanation: This slot changes storage location, team access, loss risk and resolves classification; the neighbouring slot owns backend type, locking support, concurrent writers and resolves classification.

slots.simulationOwnershipRationale: local-remote-classification is allocated to terraform-associate-004-6a (Describe the local backend) because it is one of the slot's exact objective references; one slot contributes to exactly one practice-form domain.

slots.questionIntent: Recognize that remote storage and state locking are separate backend capabilities.

expectedOutcome.resolution: Verify documented locking support instead of assuming every remote backend locks state.

slots.errorModelOrFailureMode: Equate remote persistence with automatic locking support.
slots.decisiveBoundary: The backend documentation must explicitly support locking for locking-dependent collaboration.
overlapExclusions: Does not duplicate active-versus-stale lock diagnosis.

slots.questionIntent: Select remote state storage when local persistence creates loss, secret-exposure, or collaboration risk.

expectedOutcome.resolution: Choose a supported remote storage model that satisfies secure access and shared-state needs.

slots.transferBoundary: Transfer to local state only when an isolated workflow accepts the documented durability and collaboration limits.
overlapExclusions: Does not prescribe one cloud vendor backend.
